generation: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production-ready transparent PNG sticker atlas for a lightweight video editor. Square image, ideally 2048 x 2048, EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equally sized cells, no visible grid lines, no background, genuine alpha transparency. Every sticker is separate, fully contained and centered within its cell, with at least 15 percent clear padding from every cell edge; no element crosses cells. Consistent premium playful puffy 3D illustration with glossy clay-like rounded forms, subtle soft self-shadow, clean thick white sticker border around each individual silhouette. Vivid coral, lavender, mint, golden yellow, blue palette, readable at small sizes. Row 1 left to right: a thumbs-up hand; a red heart with small sparkles; a happy laughing round face; a surprised round face. Row 2: a bright flame; a cluster of three golden stars; a yellow lightning bolt; a golden trophy. Row 3: a curved arrow pointing right; a curved arrow pointing left; a blank white speech bubble with lavender outline; a red exclamation mark on a small comic burst. Row 4: a cute takeaway coffee cup; a compact lavender camera; a confetti party popper; a small colorful rocket. No letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no logos, no checkerboard baked into image, no scene-wide shadows. Only the 16 sticker illustrations on transparent empty canvas. Uniform cell alignment is critical because this sheet will be cropped automatically into a 4x4 grid.
cleanup: Edit this sticker atlas only. Preserve all 16 existing puffy 3D stickers, their designs, colors and exact 4 by 4 grid order. Remove ALL stray white speckles, white grunge, pixel dust, irregular noise and cloudy remnants between stickers. Leave truly clean alpha transparency in all empty space. Keep the intentional clean white sticker silhouette borders. Each individual sticker must be completely isolated and must fit inside its own equal grid cell without crossing the cell boundary; reduce each uniformly a little if necessary to leave 12 percent clean transparent padding. Preserve the 4 by 4 layout exactly. No new stickers, no text, no background or checkerboard. Output clean transparent PNG.
